observations.behavior: Adds date-range and HogQL escaping helpers; changes the query node type and chart settings; adds a row-limit and fill-step for the flag evaluations volume chart; adds a retention-window clamp and date-option filter; updates the unique-callers aggregation and group-filter; changes the chart type and its breakdown; and updates the test expectations and assertions.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a date-range filter and row-limit to the HogQL query for flag evaluations, and adds a fill-step and ordering to preserve period continuity; this could prevent full-window scans and row-dropoff, and could preserve period continuity in the chart. This could help PostHog users by reducing query cost and preserving period continuity in the chart.
